structured_output.title: Cloudflare DNS01 fix: issuer configuration not visible in environment
structured_output.content: The change fixes DNS01 issuance on Cloudflare after a Cloudflare API breaking change. The environment summary shows only a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It lists no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifest or CRD, so it does not show whether a DNS01 solver or Cloudflare is configured. The operator should check their Issuer/ClusterIssuer definitions for a dns01 solver with cloudflare; if one exists, this fix is relevant to them.
